model_annotation: This bar chart illustrates negative log probability values for per-specialty terms across different fine-tuned models. The horizontal axis displays six categories: Cardio, Gastro, Infect, Neuro, Obstetrics, and Pediatrics. The vertical axis, labeled "Negative log probability," features a linear scale ranging from -27 to -22, with tick labels presented at intervals of approximately one unit. Six groups of bars are present, each corresponding to a distinct fine-tuned model, color-coded as follows: Cardio (brown), Gastro (orange), Infect (yellow), Neuro (light brown), Obstetrics (light blue), and Pediatrics (light blue). The Cardio model's bars are the tallest with a value of approximately -22.7, while the Neuro model's bars are the shortest, with a value around -24.8. The bars within each group appear to generally increase in height moving from left to right across the categories; for example, the Gastro model bars rise from approximately -24.3 to -22.3, alongside a similar trend visible for the Infect model. No bars are visually emphasized through shading, bolding, or outlining.
